events.observed_signal: The first disposable-browser preflight created and destroyed its profile safely but timed out before a TikTok response because a paused Fetch request was not answered while Page.navigate awaited its command response.

correction.action: Answered Fetch.requestPaused events immediately without waiting recursively, preserved the separate preconnect ledger, and added deterministic CDP interleaving coverage.

events.schema_impact: Added an explicit correction-resume path while preserving the sanitized evidence contract.
events.quality_impact: Prevents an implementation deadlock from being mistaken for provider access evidence.

learning.reusable_lesson: CDP interception must service paused requests even while another command response is pending.
learning.future_prevention: Exercise paused-event interleaving deterministically before a live browser preflight.

events.observed_signal: The corrected preflight reached TikTok, but both topic pages exposed zero candidates while all non-tiktok.com subresources were blocked.

correction.action: Allowed only known TikTok public delivery suffixes required for rendering while retaining the browser third-party-cookie block and blocking unrelated hosts.

events.schema_impact: No provider payload or network URL was added to evidence.
events.quality_impact: Permits public rendering without broad third-party access or cookie persistence.

learning.reusable_lesson: A tiktok.com-only subresource rule can block provider-owned assets required by the public application.
learning.future_prevention: Keep the resource allowlist explicit, provider-owned, and covered by negative host tests.

events.observed_signal: Rendered pages reached TikTok with first-party session state but exposed no canonical video anchors to the anchor-only extractor.

correction.action: Added in-page structured-state traversal that returns only sanitized creator/video identities and discards raw DOM and script state.

events.schema_impact: Added no raw structured-state field; only canonical candidate records remain returnable.
events.quality_impact: Expands identity discovery without weakening stable-ID or official-host requirements.

learning.reusable_lesson: Public video identities may live in rendered structured state rather than anchor nodes.
learning.future_prevention: Test both canonical anchors and sanitized structured-state identity shapes.

events.observed_signal: Sanitized DOM and structured-state extraction still returned zero candidates after two provider-reached topic navigations.

correction.action: Inspected bounded page-initiated public JSON in memory, extracted only canonical identity fields, and discarded every raw body.

events.schema_impact: Added aggregate inspection counts only; response bodies and endpoints remain absent.
events.quality_impact: Allows official browser-initiated state to contribute candidates without becoming retained raw evidence.

learning.reusable_lesson: Rendered applications can keep result identity in page-initiated JSON rather than DOM state.
learning.future_prevention: Use bounded in-memory parsing with canonical field projection and immediate raw-body disposal.

events.observed_signal: The page loaded provider-owned delivery resources, but response inspection considered only tiktok.com JSON MIME declarations and found no identities.

correction.action: Aligned inspection with the explicit TikTok delivery allowlist, parsed only completed XHR/fetch JSON values within the byte bound, waited for rendering, and persisted counts only.

events.schema_impact: Operation rows gained sanitized response-count telemetry and no network identities.
events.quality_impact: Makes absence diagnostics attributable without exposing provider responses.

learning.reusable_lesson: The inspection boundary must match the already authorized render resource boundary.
learning.future_prevention: Record only aggregate response and candidate counts for each finalized navigation.

events.observed_signal: Headless contexts reached hundreds of TikTok responses and inspected public JSON but produced no stable search identities.

correction.action: Used a normal visible Edge process with the same unique temporary profile, CDP controls, host allowlist, cookie boundary, and teardown proof; no stealth or bypass was added.

events.schema_impact: None; execution-environment behavior changed without adding evidence fields.
events.quality_impact: Produced 12 stable equipment candidates while preserving the public unauthenticated boundary.

learning.reusable_lesson: A normal ephemeral browser can expose public application behavior that headless rendering does not reproduce.
learning.future_prevention: Treat normal versus headless execution as an explicit tested environment choice, never as bypass behavior.

events.observed_signal: The first query in each fresh context returned zero candidates while the second equipment query returned 12-14 stable identities; only twenty-seven provider operations remained.

correction.action: Narrowed the lesson query and added a fail-closed reservation that stops before an operation if the remaining provider budget cannot complete both required rounds.

events.schema_impact: None; query and budget policy changed inside the existing evidence schema.
events.quality_impact: Prevents partial verification from consuming operations required for independent reproduction.

learning.reusable_lesson: Live search planning must reserve the complete future verification contract, not only the next request.
learning.future_prevention: Recompute minimum future provider operations before every candidate verification.

events.observed_signal: Across repeated fresh contexts the first search navigation returned zero candidates while the second returned a populated equipment set.

correction.action: Replaced two topic-specific searches with one official home warm-up and one broad diving discovery set per round, with local topic qualification and exact future-budget reservation.

checks: one warm-up plus one discovery per round

events.schema_impact: None; the ledger uses existing sanitized operation classifications.
events.quality_impact: Avoids treating an empty first navigation as content absence and preserves the two-context contract.

learning.reusable_lesson: Fresh public application contexts may require one attributable top-level warm-up before search results appear.
learning.future_prevention: Model warm-up as a counted provider operation and include it in feasibility arithmetic.

events.observed_signal: The warmed broad-discovery attempt stopped before provider response when a 1,230,407-byte CDP frame exceeded the WebSocket library default 1 MiB ceiling.

correction.action: Set a bounded 10 MB CDP frame ceiling, preserved the technical-failure history, and allowed only an exact evidence-validated correction resume.

events.schema_impact: Added a sanitized technical-failure history without raw frames.
events.quality_impact: Prevents large public CDP events from becoming false provider failures while retaining a finite memory bound.

learning.reusable_lesson: Browser automation transport limits must accommodate provider event frames without becoming unbounded.
learning.future_prevention: Pin and regression-test a finite CDP message ceiling above observed public frame sizes.

events.observed_signal: Final evidence contains seventeen provider-reached operations, two preconnect failures, zero retained lesson records, and twenty-three provider operations remaining while two complete warm/discover/verify rounds require at least twenty-four.

correction.action: Stopped live TikTok work, persisted the missing entered P58-02 declaration and exact budget proof, and prohibited adapter, Registry V3, fixture, MTC, Analysis handoff, PR, or merge creation.

events.schema_impact: No adapter registry, source manifest, run manifest, fixture, MTC, or Analysis artifact was created.
events.quality_impact: Prevents a false-green source completion when equipment discovery exists but the required lesson track and repeated verification do not.

learning.reusable_lesson: A usable single-topic discovery signal is not a two-topic Minimum Trusted Connection.
learning.future_prevention: Require new human authority and a budget that covers warm-up, discovery, twenty official verifications, and bounded failures before replaying P58.
